biggest_catch: The friend must do $500 in incoming ACH/direct deposit AND 8 debit transactions within 60 days - if they fall short, neither of you gets the card.
catches: Referring member earns a $25 Mastercard PrePaid Card per friend who joins and meets the requirements; the friend also earns $25.

Friend must: open a new savings and checking account ($5/$25 minimum deposits), make 8+ debit card transactions, have $500+ in incoming ACH/direct deposit, and have a valid email - all within 60 days of account opening.
Referrer must register at honorcu.com/refer-a-friend/ to get a custom referral link; friend must open their account with the same email address used for the referral.
Mastercard PrePaid Cards emailed within 30 days of meeting requirements; must be selected within 4 months of the email, then used within 7 months.
Up to $500 in Mastercard PrePaid Cards per calendar year (20 referrals).
Reward may be reported on IRS forms and may be considered taxable income.
All current members in good standing are eligible; new member must be eligible for Honor CU membership.
